AMENDING TEXT

⊙ Act No. 21065 (October 1, 2025)

Act Partially Amending the Government Organization Act

[Main text omitted]

ADDENDA

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, with respect to statutes amended under Article 7 of the Addenda that have been promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, the provisions amending such statutes shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective statutes ... <omitted> ... .
1. and 2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to other Acts) Paragraphs (1) through (385) Omitted.
(386) The Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows:
In Article 5(1) and (2), the main sentence of Article 5(4), Article 5(5), Article 6(2), Article 7(1) through (3), the introductory part of Article 8(1), Article 8(3), the introductory part of Article 10(1), the first sentence of Article 10(2), the introductory part of Article 10(3), Article 11(1) through (4), Article 14(3), Article 15(2), Article 16(1), the main sentence of the introductory part of Article 17(1), the main sentence of Article 19, the main sentence of the introductory part of Article 20(1), the main sentence of Article 21(2), Article 21(3), the main sentence of the introductory part of Article 22(1), the main sentence of the introductory part of Article 24(1), the introductory part of Article 25(1), Article 25(3), the main sentence of the introductory part of Article 26(1), Article 27(1) through (3), Article 29, Article 30(1), the first sentence of Article 30(2), the introductory part of Article 31, the introductory part of Article 32, and Article 34(4), "Minister of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 8(3), "Vice Minister of Environment" is replaced with "Vice Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 11(2) and (5), Article 15(4), Article 17(2), Article 18(1) and (2), Article 20(2), Article 21(5) and (7), Article 22(2), Article 24(1)6, Article 26(2), and Article 27(4), "Decree of the Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Articles 11(3) and 27(2), "Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 1 of the Act Partially Amending Five Acts, Including the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, for the Collective Transfer of Central Administrative Powers and Affairs to Local Governments (Act No. 20857), "Minister of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 1 of the Act Partially Amending Five Acts, Including the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education, for the Collective Transfer of Central Administrative Powers and Affairs to Local Governments (Act No. 20857), "Ministry of Environment" is replaced with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

Paragraphs (387) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.
